name: horda
description: PoC de shooter cooperativo de zombis (inspirado en SAS 4)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @horda/server" "npm run dev -w @horda/client"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/client
scripts.dev:boss: concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm run dev:boss -w @horda/server" "npm run dev -w @horda/client"
